name: Typographical error in question

title: ''

---

## Question details
__Chapter number__
Put the chapter number here
__Question__
e.g. Application Q1
__Beginning of question__ _(optional)_
To avoid confusion if question numbers change, would be helpful if you could copy the first part of the question so it is identifiable. E.g. "An aerosol distribution has two modes..."

## Error details
__Causes question to be incorrect__
If the typo makes a question factually incorrect or unsolvable, write __Yes__ here, otherwise write __No__. For instance, a misspelling of "aerosol" would be normally be no. Accidentally referring to "Aitken mode" when the author clearly means "accumulation mode" would normally be yes.

__Error__
Report the typo and its location. here E.g. In the hint, it says "The gas methane (with formula $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$)"

__Suggested solution__
What you think the text should say. E.g. "Change $\mathrm{CO}_{2}$ to $\mathrm{CH}_{4}$".

_P.S. Why not have a go at making a pull request to resolve this issue yourself?_
